items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] The President was Clyde Wallach then? Johnny Mercer? [INTERVIEWEE] No. It was the one that married one of the King Sisters.

ctx.x: maybe I can find out about them later on and let you know. But she had 2 hits right up there in that room.
The President was Clyde Wallach then? Johnny Mercer?

No. It was the one that married one of the King Sisters. What was his name? He married one of the King Sisters. I can see him; I can always see the people, but I forget their names. Nice man. Now I draw a blank on him, but I'll think of his name.
